title: You are safe but shaken
body: It is normal to feel fear after danger. Breathe slowly. Sit somewhere safe. Tell one person you trust you are okay.
voice_hint: You are safe. It is normal to feel fear. Breathe slowly. Tell someone you trust you are okay.

title: You dey safe but fear catch you
body: E normal to feel fear after wahala. Breathe slow. Sit for safe place. Call person wey you trust.
voice_hint: You dey safe. Fear dey normal. Breathe slow. Call person wey you trust.

title: Kuna cikin aminci
body: Yana da al'ada a ji tsoro bayan hatsari. Ku yi numfashi a hankali. Ku zauna a wuri mai aminci.
voice_hint: Kuna cikin aminci. Yi numfashi a hankali.

title: Talk to someone
body: If you need to talk, contact a trusted NGO or counsellor in your state. SafeAlert does not replace professional care.
voice_hint: If you need to talk, contact a trusted helper in your area.

title: You are not alone
body: Many Nigerians watch out for each other on the road. Your circle and community reports help others travel safer.
voice_hint: You are not alone. Your community helps others stay safe.
